items.title: Kalshi daily volume of ‘perps’ trading begins to top its prediction markets
items.summary: Kalshi is known for its prediction markets across sports , politics and culture .

items.title: Utah drops criminal charges against Kalshi founders after company suspended operations in state
items.summary: Utah on Tuesday dismissed criminal charges against Kalshi and its two co-founders following the decision by the prediction market platform on Monday to suspend operations in the state.

items.title: Fed's John Williams indicates higher interest rates likely 'over time' to address inflation
items.summary: New York Federal Reserve President John Williams said Monday that policymakers have more work to do to bring inflation under control, though he indicated that further action can unfold over time as the economy continues to grow.

items.title: Employees at Eric Trump-backed robot startup lose health benefits as company's cash crunch deepens
items.summary: Employees at Foundation Future Industries were told that their health benefits through administrator Rippling have been terminated, according to a memo obtained by CNBC, adding to mounting signs of financial distress at the humanoid robot startup advised and backed by Eric Trump .

items.title: ‘This establishes a bottom’: Jensen Huang’s return seen as likely to stop market sell-off, for now
items.summary: The major averages of U.S. equities surged on Monday after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, giving investors some hope that the relentless selling pressure seen last week may subside — at least temporarily.

items.title: Consumer confidence shoots up after Democrats' midterm victories — though inflation worries persist
items.summary: Consumers grew significantly more optimistic in November in the wake of the midterm elections , with a growing number of Americans now seeing improvement in the labor market and expecting inflation to cool.

items.title: Why France is at risk of recession — and what could keep it out of one
items.summary: France's economy is flashing fresh recession warnings as businesses delay decisions ahead of the 2027 election — but resilient industries, progress on the budget and lower energy costs could help keep growth positive.
